svg.title: Counting artefact: exact doubling and halving of the displayed rate
svg.desc: Two three-minute synthetic strips with external toco. Doubling: displayed rate jumps from 100 to 200 bpm at 1 minute and back to 100 at 2 minutes while independent ultrasound checks stay at 100. Halving: displayed rate jumps from 190 to 95 and back to 190 while checks stay at 190. Open diamonds mark the independent fetal-rate checks.
